messages:
jon_support: Heads-up: AstraMed still seeing seat activation failures after yesterday's token rotation. Case #4521. Renewal in ~18 days, customer concerned.

sasha_csm: Ugh. Do we have the exact error and whether rollback was attempted?

jon_support: Error snippet:
```
ERROR 401 auth_token_invalid tenant=astra-432
module=auth kms: decrypt failed: key_version_mismatch
req=0a1b2c3d
```
We rolled back rotation for the tenant which helped some users but not all.

maria_cs: Are they on Dedicated or Private infra? Need to know escalation window constraints.

raj_se: Dedicated (eu-west-1). Root cause: KMS key cache didn't refresh post-rotation; some inference nodes served stale key. Patch ready to force cache flush + new key hotload. Will require 10 min maintenance.

sasha_csm: Ok. I'll propose a short maintenance window to the customer and include a credit offer. Looping @ben_sales for renewal context.

ben_sales: Please include renewal watch note. Theyre sensitive — offer should be one month onboarding credit + priority support for 2 weeks.

jon_support: Customer message: "If this blocks activation our go-live slips — we need handoff to CS ASAP."

sasha_csm: Draft comms (short):
- apology + summary of cause (token rotation cache mismatch)
- immediate mitigation we did (rollback + hotpatch planned)
- proposed maintenance: today 16:00-16:10 UTC
- offer: one month onboarding credit + 14 days priority support
- contacts: sasha_csm, raj_se (SE)
Will send after SE confirms maintenance time.

deploy-bot: rollback completed 2025-05-03T14:10:23Z. hotpatch build v1.2.4 created.

raj_se: Hotpatch applied to astra-432 at 2025-05-03T14:25Z. Token error rate dropped from ~12% to ~0.8%. Continuing validation. Will post logs by EOD.

sasha_csm: Action items:
- sasha_csm: send comms + cc ben_sales (in 30m)
- raj_se: full tenant validation + attach logs (EOD)
- jon_support: keep case updated and flag any recurrences
- maria_cs: prepare renewal note and update CRM with credit offer

jon_support: Marking support -> CS handoff complete. Will update case once comms sent.

sasha_csm: :thumbsup: I'll ping here when message is sent.
